'''Class Four''' was a level of [[planetary defense]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etahn A'baht]] posited that it would require over one-third of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Group]] to establish combat superiority over a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with Class Four rated defenses.
